summary: June brings the longest days in the north, the summer festivals and the start of the dry season on safari.
intro: Around the solstice the north has its longest days: the midnight sun above the Arctic Circle, light evenings across Scandinavia and the British Isles, and outdoor festivals everywhere, from music fields to midsummer bonfires.

It's winter in the southern hemisphere, so the ski season starts in New Zealand and the Andes, and southern Africa has dry, clear days. The monsoon arrives in India and much of South-East Asia, which makes this their low season.
